definition: Strong exertion applied to abandoning the unwholesome and cultivating the wholesome.
notes: Keep padhāna as exertion and sammā-vāyāma as effort. Both appear in the four-exertion formula -- vāyamati is the verb of effort, padahati the verb of exertion -- so a single English word for both makes one clause of the formula repeat another.

example_phrases.translation: they take hold of the feeling mind and exert themselves
example_phrases.notes: The verb form closing each clause of the four-exertion formula.
